result.title: RECAP: Context-Aware Prediction Recycling with Request-Local and Persistent Memories for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
result.summary: Recycling a target model's own predictions offers a training-free source of proposals for speculative decoding. In vision-language models, however, existing recycling indexes predictions by the last token alone, conflating predictions computed under different images and prefixes; we find that such reuse fails most often at image-sensitive decoding states. Longer keys reduce this aliasing but match fewer states. We introduce \method, which stores target predictions under one-, two-, and three-token keys: contextual memories live only for the current request and are thus implicitly conditioned on its image, while token-level memory persists across requests to retain coverage. At each lookup, entropy-confidence weighting fuses the retrieved predictions according to their key specificity and concentration. Best-first search composes the fused transitions into a candidate tree, supplemented by suffix-matched continuations, and one target pass verifies the tree under greedy decoding. Without training or an auxiliary draft model, \method\ achieves mean speedups over autoregressive decoding of $1.66\speed$ and $1.56\speed$ across seven single-turn benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.6-7B, exceeding the strongest training-free baseline, Token Recycling ($1.51\speed$ and $1.37\speed$). Our implementation is available in https://github.com/Senmo996/RECAP-official-code.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RECAP：把目标模型预测按一、二、三 token 键存储，请求内上下文记忆隐式绑定当前图像、token 级记忆跨请求保留覆盖，再用熵-置信加权融合检索结果，经 best-first 搜索组成候选树并由一次目标前向在贪心解码下验证，实现免训练的多模态推测解码加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按前缀长度区分图像敏感解码状态、并跨请求缓存预测」的键粒度与融合加权，可能为 latent 状态缓存、相似度检索及 THINK/STOP 额外计算成本核算提供可核查线索，但本身不研究视觉推理中的 latent 状态生成与使用。
